Include a suitable 'dead volume' as necessary if using a robotic dispenser. Dispense 15µL to each reaction well. Add 5µL of template (extracted RNA, controls or NTC [nuclease-free water] ). Total reaction volume is 20µL

substeps.instruction: Confirm a satisfactory positive result shows a sigmoidal curve (horizontal start, exponential rise, and horizontal plateau phase).
Verify fluorescence intensity is suitable compared to a positive control.
Identify a defined threshold (CT) value that is exceeded early in the log-linear phase.
Classify samples as negative if no curve is produced within 40 cycles.
Ensure No Template Controls (NTCs) do not produce a curve.
